candidate.name: intraday_range_amount_peak_timing_alignment_240m
candidate.mechanism: normalized temporal alignment between the session's last maximum intrabar log-range occurrence and last maximum amount occurrence
candidate.formula: r_i=log(high_i/low_i); i_range=last_argmax(r_i); i_amount=last_argmax(amount_i); score=1-abs(i_range-i_amount)/239 on the exact 240 standard bars
candidate.tie_rule: last exact maximum independently for range and amount
